Question: A workshop makes two products, A and B. Each unit of A yields a profit of 40 dollars and needs 2 hours of machining and 1 hour of assembly. Each unit of B yields a profit of 30 dollars and needs 1 hour of machining and 1 hour of assembly. This week at most 100 hours of machining and at most 80 hours of assembly are available. Production quantities may be fractional. How many units of each product should be made to maximize total profit, and what is the maximum profit?

A logistics company must move at least 300 tons of goods today using small trucks and large trucks. A small truck carries 10 tons and costs 200 dollars per trip; a large truck carries 25 tons and costs 420 dollars per trip. Each truck makes one trip. At most 8 large trucks are available; there is no limit on small trucks. The number of trucks of each type must be a whole number. Minimize the total cost. What is the minimum total cost?

Two warehouses supply two customers. Warehouse 1 has 60 units available and warehouse 2 has 40 units. Customer 1 requires 50 units and customer 2 requires 50 units. Shipping one unit costs 4 dollars from warehouse 1 to customer 1, 6 dollars from warehouse 1 to customer 2, 5 dollars from warehouse 2 to customer 1, and 3 dollars from warehouse 2 to customer 2. Determine the shipping plan that meets both customers' requirements without exceeding warehouse availability at minimum total shipping cost. What is the minimum cost?
